name: ClickUp
free_plan_limits: Unlimited tasks and members, collaborative Docs, limited storage
notes: Per user, billed yearly: Unlimited $7, Business $12. Monthly price not retrieved (pricing page was blocked; used ClickUp FAQ). AI is a paid add-on; its price varied by page.

name: Obsidian
usage_note: Sync $5 per user a month ($4 yearly); Publish $10 per site a month
since_note: Initial release March 2020, as a beta (Wikipedia).
best_for: Private notes stored as local files
notes: Priced the free app. Work use is free; a $50 per user a year commercial license is optional. Notes app, not a task board. Pricing page does not say if it is open source.

name: Trello

name: Asana
free_plan_limits: Personal plan: 2 users, unlimited tasks and projects
usage_note: Extra AI requests $0.60 each pay as you go
since_note: Company founded 2008; the product exited beta in November 2011 (Wikipedia).
best_for: Team task tracking with clear owners
notes: Per user: Starter $13.49 monthly, $10.99 billed yearly. Advanced $30.49 monthly. Starter includes only 5 AI requests per user a month. Integrations listed; API not stated.

name: Monday.com
free_plan_limits: Up to 2 seats, up to 3 boards
since_note: Started as dapulse in 2012; product commercially launched 2014 (Wikipedia).
notes: From search snippets, not the live page. Paid plans need 3 seats. Per seat billed yearly: Basic $9, Standard $12, Pro $19; Basic monthly $12. $36 = 3 seats of Standard.
